description: Public /api/v1 send/read surface and the send refactor — the risk center. Adds the API-key auth helper (src/lib/api-auth.ts), extracts the session send route's core into a shared sendTemplateMessage (src/lib/send-template.ts) WITHOUT changing the session route's observable behavior, rewrites the session route as a thin wrapper, and adds the three public routes (POST /api/v1/messages, GET /api/v1/messages/[id], GET /api/v1/templates), all authenticated only by API key. Depends on FEAT-001 (ApiKey model types + hashKey/looksLikeApiKey/isSuperAdminUser).
steps: Create src/lib/api-auth.ts per design.md §3: export interface ApiKeyContext { userId: string; apiKey: ApiKey; number: WhatsAppNumber }; export async function authenticateApiKey(request: Request): Promise<ApiKeyContext | null> — parse header via /^Bearer\s+(.+)$/, trim token, looksLikeApiKey shape-gate (return null, no DB hit), computedHash = hashKey(token), prisma.apiKey.findUnique({where:{keyHash: computedHash}}), return null if missing or revokedAt set, constant-time compare Buffer.from(computedHash,'hex') vs Buffer.from(apiKey.keyHash,'hex') with length guard + crypto.timingSafeEqual, load prisma.whatsAppNumber.findUnique({where:{id: apiKey.whatsappNumberId}}) (null -> null), fire-and-forget prisma.apiKey.update lastUsedAt (not awaited, .catch(()=>{})), return {userId: apiKey.userId, apiKey, number}; export function unauthorized() { return NextResponse.json({error:'Invalid or missing API key'}, {status:401}); }. Import hashKey/looksLikeApiKey from @/lib/api-key, prisma from @/lib/db. Never log token or hash.

Create src/lib/send-template.ts per design.md §4.1 by lifting the body of src/app/api/messages/send/route.ts from AFTER its number/template/OTP/credits input checks into sendTemplateMessage(input: SendTemplateInput): Promise<SendTemplateResult>. SendTemplateInput = { userId: string; number: WhatsAppNumber; template: Template; recipient: string; variables?: string[]; isSuperAdmin: boolean }. SendTemplateResult = { ok:true; message:{ id:string; status:'sent'; metaMessageId:string|null } } | { ok:false; code:number; error:string }. The helper owns, verbatim where possible: OTP guard (authentication category && !variables?.[0] -> {ok:false,code:400,error:'OTP code variable required for authentication template'}); credits check (non-superadmin, missing UserCredits or totalCredits<=0 -> {ok:false,code:402,error:'Insufficient credits'}); message create status:'queued' with whatsappNumberId:number.id/templateId:template.id/recipientPhone:recipient/templateVariables JSON; credit deduct (non-superadmin); resolveSendCredentials(number) in try/catch -> nulls (keep the existing console.error on throw); null-credential branch -> finalStatus 'failed', errorMessage 'WhatsApp number is not connected. Reconnect it to send messages.'; else build Meta payload incl the #131008 auth-template url-button {type:'button',sub_type:'url',index:'0',parameters:[{type:'text',text:variables[0]}]} keyed on variables?.[0], recipient.replace(/\D/g,''), language.code ?? 'en', fetch https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/{phoneNumberId}/messages, metaMessageId = metaData.messages?.[0]?.id ?? null; message update (status/sentAt/metaMessageId/errorMessage); on failure refund (non-superadmin) using the SAME isSuperAdmin boolean and return {ok:false,code:500,error:errorMessage}; on success return {ok:true,message:{id,status:'sent',metaMessageId}}. Keep the existing [Meta]/[Send] console.log/warn/error lines unchanged. Return a plain object, never a NextResponse; never read a session. Import prisma from @/lib/db and resolveSendCredentials from @/lib/whatsapp.

Rewrite src/app/api/messages/send/route.ts per design.md §4.3 as a thin session wrapper: keep session 401; four-field 400 'Missing required fields'; number findFirst (id/userId/verificationStatus:'verified') -> 400 'Invalid or unverified WhatsApp number'; template findFirst (id/userId/status:'approved') -> 400 'Template not found or not approved'; call sendTemplateMessage({userId:session.user.id, number, template, recipient, variables, isSuperAdmin: session.user.role==='superadmin'}); on !result.ok return NextResponse.json({error:result.error},{status: result.code===402?400:result.code}); on success return {id:result.message.id,status:'sent',message:'Message sent successfully'}; keep outer try/catch -> 500 'Internal server error'. Observable behavior (codes, strings, success body, OTP-before-credits-before-side-effect ordering) must be identical to the pre-refactor route; the only internal change is the 402->400 remap.

Create src/app/api/v1/messages/route.ts (POST) per design.md §5.1: const ctx = await authenticateApiKey(request); if(!ctx) return unauthorized(); zod body { recipient: z.string().min(1), templateName: z.string().min(1).optional(), templateId: z.string().min(1).optional(), variables: z.array(z.string()).optional() }.refine(b => !!b.templateName !== !!b.templateId, {message:'Provide exactly one of templateName or templateId'}) -> 400 on parse/refine failure; ignore any client number field, always use ctx.number; resolve template prisma.template.findFirst({where:{userId:ctx.userId, status:'approved', ...(templateId?{id:templateId}:{name:templateName})}}) — if NO row matches owner+name/id at all -> 404 {error:'Not found'} (requires a second lookup without status to distinguish; or: findFirst by owner+name/id first, then 400 if status!=='approved', 404 if absent) per design 'not found 404 / not approved 400'; owner = prisma.user.findUnique({where:{id:ctx.userId}, select:{email:true,role:true}}); isSuperAdmin = isSuperAdminUser(owner) computed ONCE; call sendTemplateMessage; map ok:true -> 200 {id,status,metaMessageId}; ok:false -> NextResponse.json({error},{status:result.code}) (verbatim 402/400/500); outer try/catch -> 500. Never log the key.

Create src/app/api/v1/messages/[id]/route.ts (GET) per design.md §5.2: const ctx = await authenticateApiKey(request); if(!ctx) return unauthorized(); const message = await prisma.message.findFirst({where:{id: params.id, userId: ctx.userId, whatsappNumberId: ctx.number.id}, select:{id:true,status:true,recipientPhone:true,metaMessageId:true,errorMessage:true,sentAt:true,deliveredAt:true,readAt:true,createdAt:true}}); if(!message) return NextResponse.json({error:'Not found'},{status:404}); return NextResponse.json(message). Identical 404 for not-found vs other-owner/number (no oracle). Never log the path id on any branch.

Create src/app/api/v1/templates/route.ts (GET) per design.md §5.3: const ctx = await authenticateApiKey(request); if(!ctx) return unauthorized(); read optional ?status; validate against ['draft','pending','submitted','approved','rejected'] -> 400 on unknown; prisma.template.findMany({where:{userId:ctx.userId, ...(status?{status}:{})}, select:{id:true,name:true,category:true,language:true,status:true}, orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'}}); return the list. No number filter, no credential fields.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes with api-auth.ts, send-template.ts, the rewritten session route, and all three /api/v1 routes compiling (AC2, AC18).

Static trace: POST /api/v1/messages accepts only {recipient, templateName|templateId, variables?} (XOR enforced -> 400 on both/neither), never accepts a client number/credential, always sends via ctx.number, computes isSuperAdmin once via isSuperAdminUser and passes one boolean through check/deduct/refund (AC6, AC7, AC8).
Static trace: insufficient credits -> 402 on the public route and 400 on the session route (402->400 remap), both before contacting Meta (AC9, AC15).

Static trace: GET /api/v1/messages/[id] returns identical 404 for unknown vs other-owner/other-number ids and leaks no credential; GET /api/v1/templates is scoped to ctx.userId and validates ?status (AC10, AC11).
Static trace / diff: the session send route's observable codes, strings, and success body are unchanged from the pre-refactor version except the internal 402->400 remap (NFR6, AC15).
401 matrix holds in authenticateApiKey: missing/malformed header, non-wa_live_ shape (no DB hit), unknown key, revoked key all yield null -> unauthorized() (AC12, AC13).
verification: npm run build && npm run lint must pass.

Dry static trace of the full public send path (authenticateApiKey -> template resolve -> isSuperAdminUser once -> sendTemplateMessage -> Meta fetch) confirming client cannot supply a number/credential and the credit math is symmetric.
Diff the rewritten src/app/api/messages/send/route.ts behavior against the pre-refactor route (status codes, error strings, success body, guard ordering); confirm only the 402->400 remap differs.
grep -rn "wa_live_|keyHash" src across api-auth.ts and the /api/v1 routes to confirm no plaintext/hash is logged (AC16).
findings:
COMPLETED. Files created: src/lib/api-auth.ts, src/lib/send-template.ts, src/app/api/v1/messages/route.ts, src/app/api/v1/messages/[id]/route.ts, src/app/api/v1/templates/route.ts. Rewrote src/app/api/messages/send/route.ts as a thin session wrapper. scratchpad.md updated (public API section + backend table rows + dated change log entry).

--- Public route paths + status codes (for FEAT-003 docs/management UI) ---
POST /api/v1/messages: auth Bearer wa_live_ only. Body {recipient:string, templateName?:string, templateId?:string, variables?:string[]} with XOR refine (both/neither template key -> 400 {error:'Provide exactly one of templateName or templateId'}). Ignores any client number/credential; always uses ctx.number (the key's bound WhatsAppNumber). Template resolved owner-scoped: no owner row -> 404 {error:'Not found'}; row exists but status!=='approved' -> 400 {error:'Template not found or not approved'}. isSuperAdmin via isSuperAdminUser(owner) computed ONCE (owner missing -> 401 unauthorized()). Success 200 {id, status:'sent', metaMessageId}. Failure maps helper code VERBATIM: 400 (missing OTP), 402 (insufficient credits), 500 (not-connected / Meta non-2xx, refund already applied). Outer catch -> 500 {error:'Internal server error'}.
GET /api/v1/messages/[id]: 401 if !ctx; else prisma.message.findFirst scoped {id, userId:ctx.userId, whatsappNumberId:ctx.number.id}, select allow-list {id,status,recipientPhone,metaMessageId,errorMessage,sentAt,deliveredAt,readAt,createdAt}; no match (unknown OR other-owner/other-number) -> identical 404 {error:'Not found'}; path id never logged.
GET /api/v1/templates: 401 if !ctx; optional ?status validated against ['draft','pending','submitted','approved','rejected'] -> 400 {error:'Invalid status. Allowed: ...'} on unknown; prisma.template.findMany scoped userId, select {id,name,category,language,status}, orderBy createdAt desc.
Shared 401 body (unauthorized()): {error:'Invalid or missing API key'}, status 401. authenticateApiKey returns null (no oracle) for: missing/malformed Bearer header, non-wa_live_ shape (no DB hit), unknown keyHash, revokedAt set, vanished bound number.

--- One-time-reveal response shape expectation (for FEAT-003 POST /api/api-keys) ---
This FEAT does NOT create the management routes (that is FEAT-003). The plaintext key is the ONLY secret ever returned, exactly once, by POST /api/api-keys (design §6.2/§6.4): 201 body = the create() select projection {id, name, keyPrefix, whatsappNumberId, lastUsedAt, revokedAt, createdAt} PLUS key: plaintext. keyHash is NEVER present in any response; subsequent GET /api/api-keys returns the same projection WITHOUT key and WITHOUT keyHash. generateApiKey() (FEAT-001) returns {plaintext, hash, prefix}: plaintext = 'wa_live_' + base64url(32 random bytes) (len 51), prefix = 'wa_live_' + first 4 random chars (len 12). Store keyHash + keyPrefix only; never the plaintext.

--- Session route unchanged (parity confirmation) ---
git diff of src/app/api/messages/send/route.ts shows the body-below-input-checks lifted verbatim into sendTemplateMessage and replaced by a single call + a 402->400 remap. Observable parity verified by trace: session 401 'Unauthorized'; 400 'Missing required fields'; number 400 'Invalid or unverified WhatsApp number'; template 400 'Template not found or not approved'; OTP 400 'OTP code variable required for authentication template' (still first, before any credit/message mutation); insufficient credits -> 400 'Insufficient credits' (helper 402 remapped); failure -> 500 with same errorMessage after refund; success body {id, status:'sent', message:'Message sent successfully'}; outer catch -> 500 'Internal server error'. The ONLY behavioral change is the internal 402->400 remap. All [Send]/[Meta] console lines moved verbatim.

npm run build (prisma generate && next build) -> exit 0; /api/v1/messages, /api/v1/messages/[id], /api/v1/templates all listed as compiled lambda routes. grep -rn 'wa_live_|keyHash' src -> only PREFIX constant (api-key.ts) + keyHash as a Prisma where/compare field (api-auth.ts); NO console logging of plaintext/hash in api-auth.ts, send-template.ts, or any /api/v1 route. Static trace: POST /api/v1/messages never accepts a client number/credential (zod schema has no such field; always ctx.number), isSuperAdmin computed once, credit check/deduct/refund all gated on the same boolean. npm run lint could not run (pre-existing: no ESLint config -> next lint interactive prompt hangs; same as FEAT-001); the lint pass inside next build passed. No prisma db push. Committed on current branch; NOT pushed, no worktree.
